reviewer: same continuing independent App Designer Pro native critic
scope: Proposed one-time reveal of actual busy Cancel after layout. Motivation is actual Source184main/normal legacy/encrypted busy3/4clipping; transaction/cancellation mechanics not diagnosed as broken by those stills.
readBoundary: Current canonical production view/model files read. Active186UItest/build/runtime untouched. Prior images were actually opened in their original contributions; no additional image-open credit in this audit.
assessment: A Cancel row with a stable scroll ID and one owned nonanimated reveal per actual operation is a minimal native response to the observed bottom clipping. Keep existing error copy/layout/focus behavior. Current active/busy/same-control guards and disappearance cancellation appropriately prevent a completed/old review from revealing the new row. Do not broaden this into repeated snapping or focus stealing.

requiredRefinements.kind: source timing gap; inferred, not observed runtime defect
requiredRefinements.location: Cancel action and busyReveal task guard
requiredRefinements.finding: The proposed Cancel action cancels operation/work but leaves busyReveal pending until busy becomes false. Task cancellation can await detached-worker unwind, so busy can remain true while a pending reveal resumes after the user cancelled. The guard checks task/active/busy/control identity but not actual control cancellation.
requiredRefinements.required: In the Cancel action, cancel and clear busyReveal before cancelling operation/work. Before scrolling, check activeOperation cancellation and return silently on cancellation, in addition to existing task/active/busy/same-control guards. Preserve silent cancellation and do not convert a cancellation check into a user error.
requiredRefinements.verification: In held control2 Cancel case retain actual full Cancel before native tap without test scrolling, then sample no stale reveal/error during unwind; independently prove actual control cancelled, UI/worker match, stage removed and no receipt. Ordinary sampled checks do not prove every yield window.

requiredRefinements.location: plan.hostRequirements exact live canonical/prior bytes and metadata
requiredRefinements.finding: Preparation can legitimately retire the original .previous folder before the held barrier. BackupFileTransaction.prepare calls BackupFiles.recover, which preserves prior contents privately then removes .previous, before creating/pausing preparation stage. Requiring the original prior path/metadata unchanged after held2 would incorrectly fail expected existing behavior.
requiredRefinements.required: Specify canonical current payload bytes/metadata preservation separately from allowed private-preservation additions, and explicitly bind prior contents/intent to exact private copies/manifests once .previous retires. Record actual original-prior presence/absence at each boundary; require no loss or substitution, rather than impossible old-path identity. Preserve every prior private copy through Cancel/Back, retry, final receipt and relaunch.
requiredRefinements.verification: At first genuine failed boundary preserve pre-preparation original current/prior metadata as before. At held2/cancelled boundary inventory any legitimate private copies, compare preserved raw prior contents to baseline, and prove unrelated healthy/current source/provider exact. Never bypass failed receipt/stage or missing-copy assertions by ignoring arbitrary extra files.

lifecycleAnalysis: recover() runs on MainActor, sets busy then creates and assigns actual operation synchronously before returning to a normal render. onChange sees the inserted busy rows under ordinary operation. Closed acquire can set busy back false without creating a genuine operation; no forced reveal/error should be manufactured for that cancellation-only path.

Capturing activeOperation and checking identity after Task.yield prevents a stale reveal targeting a later control. Cancellation on busyfalse/disappearance plus guard busy/reviewActive blocks late completion/error scroll races. The short task need not repeatedly poll or retain source payloads.

onChange(of:busy) is a Boolean event, so it is not a universal proof of every theoretical coalesced operation transition. Current private UI route disables concurrent recovery while busy; no demonstrated need for a broader state redesign. Keep per-operation identity guards and test actual repeated attempts.

One Task.yield is a scheduling opportunity, not a formal layout-completion barrier. Do not claim it guarantees a valid Form scroll target from source alone. Fresh originals must show full Cancel after actual row insertion; if a layout race is reproduced, prefer target-row/operation-bound lifecycle rather than arbitrary sleep or repeated scrolling.

scrollTo has no explicit animation wrapper and does not assign AccessibilityFocusState. It can still affect viewport/accessibility behavior; direct VoiceOver and Reduce Motion remain fresh gates after production modification. Do not inherit genuine-error speech acceptance from pre-change186.

The existing genuine-error task must remain cancelled/reset on retry and guarded by failure UUID/current review. A failure that ends busy should cancel the busy reveal and allow the owned genuine-error reveal/focus to remain authoritative.
